description: Exploit, as a time-neutral accuracy booster that would fund the trims. E016's post-mortem points to the BN-bias wd (bias lr = 64 × lr) as the active part. On the E016 recipe, cut weight decay to ×0.25 of the original on the SGD groups only (BN biases, whitening bias, head), leaving the Muon conv-filter wd at E016's ×0.5. First check in code whether the filters are renormalized; if they are, filter wd is inert and this is equivalent to a global cut. Nothing else changes. Recapture the graphs if wd is baked in as a constant.
